```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Year

```{r year}
df <- read.csv("data/repeated_ids.csv")

time_to_minutes <- function(time_str) {
  parts <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(time_str, ":")))
  if(length(parts) == 3) {
    return(parts[1] * 60 + parts[2] + parts[3]/60)
  } else {
    return(parts[1] + parts[2]/60)
  }
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Time_Mins = sapply(Official.Time, time_to_minutes),
)
ggplot(df, aes(x = Year, y = Time_Mins)) +
  # Create the blue shaded CI area (stela)
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, 
               geom = "ribbon", 
               fill = "blue", 
               alpha = 0.2) + 
  # Create the red mean line
  stat_summary(fun = mean, 
               geom = "line", 
               color = "red", 
               size = 1) +
  # Add mean points for clarity
  stat_summary(fun = mean, 
               geom = "point", 
               color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Mean Official Time with 95% CI Ribbon",
       subtitle = "Blue area = 95% CI, Red line = Mean",
       y = "Minutes",
       x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r age}

ggplot(df, aes(x = Age)) +
  # Create the histogram with specific binwidth and colors
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 2,           # Adjust this to match the bar thickness in your image
    fill = "#ff721f",       # The specific vibrant orange color
    color = "white",        # Thin white border between bars
    size = 0.3              # Border thickness
  ) +
  # Set the x-axis breaks to match the image (30, 50, 70)
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50, 70)) +
  # Apply a clean theme
  theme_minimal() +
  # Fine-tune the labels and grid
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),         # Remove minor grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#ebebeb"), # Light grey grid lines
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "#555555")
  )
  
```

```{r age2}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = Time_Mins)) +
  # Add the points. 
  # alpha = 0.1 makes them very transparent so they don't overlap into a solid blob.
  # size = 0.5 makes the dots small.
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.5, color = "black") +
  
  # Add the red trend line (GAM or LOESS smoothing)
  # se = TRUE adds the grey confidence interval seen in your image
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", color = "red", fill = "grey80", size = 1.2) +
  
  # Set labels
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Finish time (hours)"
  ) +
  
  # Styling to match the image
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#ebebeb"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

```
```{r gender}

# 2. Create the plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = M.F, y = Time_Mins, fill = M.F)) +
  # Draw the violin plot
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
  # Add the narrow white boxplot inside
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", color = "black", outlier.size = 1) +
  # Match the colors from the image (Coral and Teal)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("F" = "#f68d83", "M" = "#5cc9c1")) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    x = "Gender",
    y = "Finish time (minutes)",
    fill = "gender"
  ) +
  # Theme and styling
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), # Remove vertical grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

```
Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r country}
df <- read.csv("data/repeated_ids_with_countries.csv")
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Time_Mins = sapply(Official.Time, time_to_minutes),
)
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(Country, Year) %>%
  summarise(mean_finish_time = mean(Time_Mins, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = Year, y = mean_finish_time, color = Country, group = Country)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Finishing Time by Country",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Mean Finish Time (Minutes)",
    color = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
```{r}
top_countries <- df %>%
  count(Country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  pull(Country)

# Filter the summarized data to only include those 10
filtered_summary <- summary_df %>%
  filter(Country %in% top_countries)

# Plot the filtered data
ggplot(filtered_summary, aes(x = Year, y = mean_finish_time, color = Country, group = Country)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Mean Finish Time (Minutes)")

ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Country, Time_Mins, FUN = median), y = Time_Mins)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Country", y = "Finish Time (Minutes)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = Time_Mins)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  geom_density(color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Race Time Distribution with Density Curve",
    x = "Time (Minutes)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(scales) # Required for nice labels

ggplot(df, aes(x = Time_Mins)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "firebrick", color = "white", bins = 50) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
                labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
  labs(
    title = "Time Distribution on Log10 Scale",
    x = "Minutes (Log Scale)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
